g.aria-label: Unifying Published Objectives via w(λ) = 2 c(t) p(t) |dt / dλ|
Continuous ELBO / Variational Diffusion (Kingma et al.)
Weights all log-SNR scales equally; optimal for exact NLL / bits
Monotone decreasing; suppresses high-λ noise for lower FD
Focuses capacity on mid-noise scales where structure forms
Changing target c(t), path λ_t, or time sampling p(t) simply reshapes one curve w(λ)
